svg.title: Selected MAP performance and conceptual interpretation
svg.desc: Panel A, computed: ensemble meta-score S of the selected MAP candidate in inference rounds 1 to 5 for the eight ICM geometries; seven geometries reach the upper bound S = 1 in round 5 and the largest geometry reaches 0.9771. Each geometry has its own marker symbol and colour. Panels B to D, illustrative: PRE/EPI target organization for three ICM sizes; the hypothesized contribution of initial cavity-associated FGF4; and the sequence biological target, goal-conditioned parameter exploration, forward evaluation.
svg.text: Selected MAP performance and conceptual interpretation
Cell size fixed; larger ICMs contain more cells
Hypothesized contribution of initial cavity-associated FGF4
Computed meta-scores summarize selected MAP ensembles; panels B–D illustrate the target and model
